Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

We have great people who do exceptional work. We take pride in building an environment of continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. The Executive Assistant is a high-trust, senior-level administrative partner responsible for providing comprehensive executive, operational, and governance support to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO), Chief Research & Operations Officer (CROO), and broader People & Culture and GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) functions. 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support, acting as a central hub across leadership, ensuring seamless execution of executive priorities, governance processes, internal workflows, and organizational operations. The incumbent is expected to anticipate needs, proactively improve systems, and drive efficiency across tools, processes, and leadership workflows. 

Key areas of responsibility include executive calendar and priority management, cross-functional coordination, governance and compliance support (including DocuSign and approval workflows), onboarding/offboarding governance alignment, financial tracking support, and leadership communications preparation. 

This role requires a high degree of discretion, judgment, organizational maturity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment. In-office attendance is required minimum twice per week, with additional presence as needed based on executive priorities and business needs. 

\n


What you will do

Executive & Leadership Support 

  • Provide high-level administrative and operational support to the CGO, CROO, and Leadership Team, including complex calendar management, prioritization of competing demands, and proactive scheduling optimization  

  • Coordinate executive meetings, leadership forums, and cross-functional working sessions, including agendas, briefing materials, and follow-ups  

  • Prepare and synthesize meeting notes, action items, and executive summaries as required  

  • Manage domestic and international travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics with a focus on efficiency and executive readiness  

 

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) & Workflow Support 

  • Support governance workflows including DocuSign routing, approval tracking, documentation integrity, and compliance-related administrative processes  

  • Maintain structured documentation across Confluence, SharePoint, Monday.com, and other workflow systems to ensure audit readiness and process consistency  

  • Support adherence to internal approval frameworks, ensuring proper routing, documentation, and tracking of executive-level decisions and sign-offs  

  • Identify and implement improvements to governance workflows, documentation standards, and operational procedures  

 

People & Culture (P&C) Support 

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes in partnership with P&C and IT, ensuring consistent, compliant, and well-documented execution  

  • Takes a lead with internal initiatives aligned to corporate leadership priorities  i.e. plans corporate events 

  • Supports the P&C team with organizing both virtual and in person activities throughout the year 


Financial & Operational Support 

  • Manage executive-level expense tracking, credit card reconciliation, invoice submissions, and purchase order processing  

  • Support budget tracking and reporting accuracy for leadership-related expenditures  

  • Liaise with Finance as required to ensure timely and accurate processing of financial documentation  

 

Office & Operational Management 

  • Oversee office operations coordination, including supplies, vendor coordination, facilities requests, and workplace logistics  

  • Act as primary liaison with building management and internal operations teams for office needs (repairs, access, seating, meeting setup, etc.)  

  • Support in-person meeting and event logistics, including setup, coordination, and post-event wrap-up  

  • Manages the office space, orders supplies, kitchen stock up of drinks and snacks

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

employer: Canadian Armed Forces | Forces armÃ©es canadiennes
description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Infantry Soldiers are the Armyâs primary combat fighters and are responsible for closing with and destroying the enemy. They are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armour Soldiers.

Infantry Soldiers are capable of operating anywhere in the world in any environment â Arctic tundra, mountains, jungle or desert â and in any combination of arms, including airmobile and amphibious operations. The primary duties of Infantry Soldiers are to:

  • Expertly operate and maintain a wide range of weapons, including rifle, hand-grenades, light, medium and heavy machine-guns, and anti-tank weapons
  • Use sophisticated equipment for field communications, navigation and night-vision surveillance
  • Inspect and maintain weapon systems, vehicles, survival gear and personal defensive equipment
  • Participate in airborne operations
  • Operate with support elements such as fighter aircraft, tactical and artillery
  • Engage in unarmed combat
  • Employ camouflage and concealment, patrol, assault, defence, and escape-and-evasion tactics.


Work environment


Infantry Soldiers normally work outdoors. Both in training and on operations they live and work in conditions that would resemble those in the field. Infantry Soldiers will be posted to a battalion in Canada, but there are employment opportunities across Canada and on deployed operations around the world.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options

No previous work experience or career related skills are required. CAF recruiters can help you decide if your personal interests and attributes match the criteria for this occupation.

The minimum required education to apply for this occupation is the completion of the provincial requirements for Grade 10 or Secondary 4 in Quebec.

Foreign education may be accepted.

Training

The first stage of training is the Basic Military Qualification course, or Basic Training, held at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. This training provides the basic core skills and knowledge common to all trades. A goal of this course is to ensure that all recruits maintain the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) physical fitness standard; as a result, the training is physically demanding.

Infantry Soldiers attend one of three Military Training Centres: The Royal Canadian Regiment in Meaford, Ontario; Princess Patriciaâs Canadian Light Infantry in Wainwright, Alberta; and the Royal 22 e RÃ©giment in Valcartier, Quebec. The training takes 17 weeks and includes the following topics:

  • Use and care of personal and section-level weapons, including rifles, machine guns and anti-tank weapons
  • Field-craft, including personal hygiene and meal preparation, camouflage, sentry duties, signalling, selecting firing positions, tactical movements and lines of advance
  • Construction of field defences, such as trenches and roadblocks, and laying and marking of minefields
  • Navigation by day and by night
  • Patrolling operations
  • Infantry section and platoon tactics, including offensive, defensive and transitional operations

employer: Canadian Armed Forces | Forces armÃ©es canadiennes
description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Engineer Officers help the army live, move and fight. They are members of the Corps of Royal Canadian Engineers. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms.

The primary responsibility of Engineer Officers is combat readiness. Either working within Canada during an emergency or on international missions, Engineer Officers are responsible for:

  • Constructing habitable camps
  • Breaching minefields
  • Using explosives to destroy a road or bridge
  • Constructing a bridge or ferry
  • Building a combat road
  • Disposing explosives
  • Constructing obstacles


Work environment


Engineer Officers are employed at bases and stations across Canada and on deployed operations around the world. They experience the unique adventures and challenges that come with working in different environments and various terrains â Arctic tundra, tropical jungle, desert, mountains, urban complex â and various climates.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options
  • Paid Education Options

If you already have a university degree, the Forces will decide if your academic program matches the criteria for this job and may place you directly into the required on-the-job training program following basic training. Basic training and military officer qualification training are required before being assigned.

Regular Officer Training Plan

Due to the requirement for CAF officer to obtain a university degree, the CAF will pay successful recruits to complete a bachelor degree program in the Royal Military College System. Recruits will receive full-time salary including medical and dental care, as well as vacation time with full pay in exchange for working in the CAF for a period of time. Typically, candidates enter the Canadian Military College System as an Officer Cadet where they study subjects relevant to both their military and academic career. In rare instances, based on the needs of the CAF, candidates may be approved attend another Canadian University. A determination will be made on a case by case basis. If you are applying for this program, you must apply to the CAF and it is recommended to apply to other Canadian universities of your choice should you not be accepted for ROTP.

Training

After enrolment, you start basic officer training at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec, for 12 weeks. Topics covered include general military knowledge, the principles of leadership, regulations and customs of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF), basic weapons handling, and first aid. Opportunities will also be provided to apply such newly acquired military skills in training exercises involving force protection, field training, navigation and leadership. A rigorous physical fitness program is also a vital part of basic training. Basic officer training is provided in English or French and successful completion is a prerequisite for further training.

Following basic officer training, official second language training may be offered to you. Training could take from two to nine months to complete depending on your ability in your second language.

Common army phase

After basic training, you will go to the Infantry School at the Combat Training Centre in Gagetown, New Brunswick. You will build upon the leadership training you received in basic officer training in addition to learning the skills required of all Combat Arms Soldiers, including more advanced weapons-handling, field-craft, and section-level tactics.

Engineer Officers attend the Canadian Forces School of Military Engineering in Gagetown, New Brunswick. For the first two and a half months, training focuses on basic combat engineering skills and includes subjects such as:

  • Basic demolitions
  • Mine warfare
  • Obstacle construction
  • Field fortifications
  • Dismounted infantry tactics at the platoon level

It ends with a three-week field deployment where the Engineer Officerâs ability to lead a Troop is assessed. The final nine months of training concentrates on reconnaissance, planning, and Troop-level combat engineer tasks. Subjects included are:

  • Bridge building
  • Minefield construction
  • Booby-trap clearance
  • Route denial
  • Bridge demolition
  • Combat road repair and construction
  • Defensive works
  • Timber and rope field machines
  • Destruction of battlefield munitions
  • Construction of temporary camps
  • Breaching various obstacles in the face of the enemy

At the end of the last phase, during a comprehensive four-week field deployment, the skills acquired are assessed.

Engineer Officers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including after the first tour of duty with a first line unit, they may choose to specialize in one of the following areas:

  • Combat diving
  • Counter explosive threat
  • Mapping and geodesic support to joint operations
  • Infrastructure engineering to both garrison and deployed installations
  • Technical engineering to support the procurement and management of equipment

Part time options

They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Engineer Officers serve with the Canadian Army. Their primary responsibility is combat readiness â to help the army live, move and fight. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms team. When employed on a part-time or casual full-time basis they usually serve with Canadian Army units at locations within Canada.

Find a Recruiting Centre

Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards.

After completing basic officer training, Engineer Officers attend approximately three months of specialized instruction at the Canadian Forces School of Military Engineering in Gagetown, New Brunswick, where they earn their Engineer Officer qualification.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. title: Engineering Manager Thailand
description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

Â 

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology â setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality â when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

 

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

 

About the Role

Events are an important part of how we build Langdock's community. We host customer dinners, our conference "The Dock", forums, webinars, and other gatherings that bring together people who are shaping the future of work and AI.

As an Events Intern or Working Student, you will support the planning and execution of our events. You will see what it takes to run professional events from the inside - from the first planning document to the last guest leaving the room.

This is a hands-on role with lots of ownership. You will work closely with our marketing team, take responsibility for your own tasks, and learn quickly by doing.

If you are curious about how great events come together, this is your perfect learning opportunity.

 

What You Will Do

  • Support the execution of our conference, customer dinners, forums, team events, and other community activations

  • Help with event planning, timelines, checklists, guest lists, invitations, and registrations

  • Coordinate with venues, caterers, speakers, suppliers, and other external partners

  • Prepare event materials, signage, name badges, welcome packages, and other on-site details

  • Support guest communication before, during, and after events

  • Help create smooth experiences for speakers, customers, prospects, and our team

  • Be on-site during events and help make sure everything runs as planned

  • Take ownership of specific workstreams and bring them to completion

  • Help us document what worked, what did not, and how we can improve future events

 

What Makes This Different

You will not just be observing from the sidelines. You will be involved in real events and trusted with meaningful responsibilities from the beginning.

You will learn how professional events are built: how to turn an idea into a format, how to work with partners, how to manage details under time pressure, and how to create an experience that people remember for the right reasons.

Because we are a small and fast-moving team, you will have direct access to the people making decisions. You can ask questions, suggest ideas, and see the impact of your work quickly.

 

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You are curious about events, marketing, community, or communications

  • You enjoy organizing things and keeping track of details

  • You take responsibility and follow through on what you start

  • You are comfortable working on several tasks at once and staying calm when plans change

  • You communicate clearly and professionally in both German and English

  • You are hands-on and happy to help wherever needed - including on-site during events

  • You have a good sense for what makes people feel welcome and looked after

  • You are currently studying or have recently graduated, ideally in event management, marketing, communications, hospitality, business, or a related field

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you

Previous event experience is helpful, but not required. We care more about your energy, reliability, and willingness to learn.

 

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

 

Compensation

This is a paid role.

 

Next Steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

title: Founding Product Success Manager, Head of CS Track
description:

BoWatt is building agentic requirements and systems engineering software for manufacturing. We believe AI will reach PhD-level engineering capability within the next 10 years. We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

As our Founding Product Success Manager, you will sit between our customers and product team. You will own customer success after the initial sale while also playing a hands-on role in shaping and improving the product.

This is not a traditional Customer Success role. You will work directly with customers, understand their problems in depth, and work with our engineers to turn those problems into product improvements.

  • Own the customer relationship after the initial sale, from onboarding through successful adoption and long-term partnership

  • Build strong relationships with users, champions, and senior stakeholders at large Mittelstand companies and Tier-1 enterprises in the DACH region and beyond

  • Spend significant time with customers to understand their workflows, problems, and product needs

  • Drive product adoption across customer teams and help users integrate BoWatt into their day-to-day engineering processes

  • Ensure customers get measurable value from BoWatt by regularly reviewing progress, identifying blockers, and developing practical solutions

  • Run operative product management for customer-driven improvements: understand problems, define requirements, create and prioritize tickets, and work closely with engineering through implementation

  • Test new features with customers, collect feedback, and iterate together with the product and engineering teams

  • Own customer-facing software incidents and bugs end-to-end, from initial investigation and reproduction through prioritization and resolution with engineering

  • Identify opportunities to expand BoWatt within existing customers across additional teams, use cases, and business units

  • Bring structured customer feedback into the product team and help shape our product roadmap

  • Build and improve our processes for onboarding, adoption, customer feedback, product discovery, and customer success

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt's software, customers, and target industries

During your first 6 months, you will work closely with our CPO and product team to develop the product, industry, and customer knowledge needed to gradually take ownership of increasingly complex customers and product initiatives.

You

  • You genuinely enjoy working with customers and building strong, long-term relationships

  • You enjoy getting into the details of customer problems and figuring out how the product can solve them

  • You write clearly, communicate confidently, and know how to get to the point with both technical users and senior stakeholders

  • You are highly structured and take ownership of driving projects and customer initiatives to completion

  • You can understand complex customer challenges and turn them into clear, practical solutions and product requirements

  • You are proactive: you identify risks and opportunities early rather than waiting for customers to raise them

  • You are comfortable working with technical B2B products and are curious about how engineering and manufacturing teams operate

  • You are comfortable working closely with software engineers and discussing bugs, features, priorities, and trade-offs

  • You want to grow into a domain expert across our software, customers, and industry

  • You are ambitious, resourceful, and willing to go the extra mile to make customers successful

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in Customer Success, Product Management, Account Management, Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing B2B software role

  • Alternatively, experience in a technical customer-facing role at an industrial manufacturer, engineering company, or technology business

  • Experience onboarding customers, managing ongoing customer relationships, and driving product adoption

  • Experience translating customer problems and feedback into clear product requirements is a strong advantage

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and initiatives in parallel

  • Comfortable working with CRM, product management, and customer success tools

  • Ability to understand technical products and communicate effectively with both technical users and business stakeholders

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Manufacturing, engineering, product management, and/or startup experience is a bonus

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 vacation days per year, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • Significant ownership from day one

  • Direct exposure to customers, product, and engineering

  • The opportunity to help define how Product Success works at BoWatt as we scale

Interview process

  1. 30-minute screening call — Nat or Malte

  2. 60-minute interview — CPO, CEO

  3. 60-minute culture fit interview — CEO + CPO

  4. Offer and reference checks

We aim to complete the entire interview process within 14 days.

title: Enterprise Account Executive | Germany

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team shaping the future of global communication

At DeepL, we are on an exciting mission to eliminate language barriers worldwide through AI. As we scale, our Sales team serves as the ultimate driver of our global reach and customer engagement.

Germany is our single largest and most strategic market globally—making this role a pivotal, high-visibility opportunity to shape our growth story. You will join an inclusive, highly collaborative environment where sales partners seamlessly with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to deliver transformational value to leading organizations.

How you will drive impact

  • Lead Strategic Growth in Germany: Cultivate deep relationships within our key existing business while identifying opportunities to win new top-tier enterprise clients across the region.

What will set you up for success

  • Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Proven track record in complex sales cycles within the DACH region. Industry experience in Finance, High Tech, or Manufacturing is strongly preferred.

  • Account Expansion & New Business: Experience both growing existing large enterprise accounts and introducing emerging technology to new logos.

  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong ability to lead, orchestrate, and align internal cross-functional partners to solve big challenges.

  • Adaptability & Drive: Comfort navigating dynamic, fast-scaling environments with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.

  • Language Proficiency: fluency in German and English.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

title: Fullstack Engineer - Merchant EMEA
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin. 

 

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka or other streaming technologies.
  • Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

Why Join Us?

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

You can read more about our recruitment process here. here.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Steuerberater und/oder Rechtsanwalt als Gestaltungsberater für Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge (m/w/d)
description:
Die AWP Wirtschaftstreuhand GmbH ist Mitglied des Netzwerkverbunds der LKC, welchem über 30 Kanzleien deutschlandweit angehören. Die gesuchte Person wird deshalb nicht nur für die AWP als Arbeitgeber tätig sein, sondern soll im Rahmen der gesamten LKC-Gruppe ihre fachliche Kompetenz auftrags- und fallbezogen einbringen können.

Wer wir sind und was uns ausmacht.

Wir in der LKC-Gruppe bieten unseren Mandanten eine ganzheitliche Beratung in allen steuerlichen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Belangen. Als Kanzleiverbund setzen wir dabei auf digitale und effiziente Prozesse und nutzen aktiv die Chancen der Digitalisierung. Damit schaffen wir mehr Zeit für unsere Mandanten und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um die Gestaltungsberatung. Trotz des Leistungsangebots und Mandaten, wie man sie eher in Großkanzleien findet, kennen wir bei LKC unsere Kollegen persönlich und unterstützen uns gegenseitig mit unseren individuellen Stärken und Kenntnissen.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben.

Als Gestaltungsberater für Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge erwartet Sie ein spannendes und herausforderndes Tätigkeitsfeld. Als steuerlicher Experte erarbeiten Sie in engem Austausch mit dem jeweiligen mandatsverantwortlichen Partner individuelle Gestaltungskonzepte und begleiten deren Umsetzung bis zum Abschluss. Maßgeschneiderte Lösungen und Strategien werden von Ihnen entwickelt, um Unternehmen in sensiblen Umstellungsphasen erfolgreich zu begleiten. Sie führen unsere Mandanten durch steuerliche und rechtliche Herausforderungen und unterstützen sie als vertrauensvoller Partner. Hierbei fungieren Sie als standortübergreifender Berater der LKC-Gruppe. Ihren beruflichen Sitz hätten Sie je nach Ihrer privaten und familiären Orientierung in einer unserer Partnerkanzleien in Regensburg (AWP), Augsburg (GRP Günter Reitmayer GmbH & Co. KG) oder München. Ihre Beratungsaufträge werden dabei durch Kanzleien der LKC-Gruppe generiert, sodass Sie auch überregionale Aufträge bearbeiten werden, jedoch mit Schwerpunkt im süddeutschen Raum. In dieser Rolle können Sie Ihre Expertise in einem dynamischen Umfeld einsetzen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Unter anderem erwarten Sie folgende Tätigkeiten:

  • Erstellung und operative Umsetzung von Umwandlungen, Restrukturierungen sowie der Nachfolgeberatung
  • Steuerrechtliche Beratung bei der Unternehmensnachfolge und Begleitung bei der Ausarbeitung der erforderlichen Verträge und weiteren rechtlichen Maßnahmen
  • Erstellung von Gutachten und Stellungnahmen

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil.

Sie sind ein Teamplayer und finden sich in folgenden Punkten wieder? Dann freuen wir uns, Sie bei der LKC willkommen zu heißen.

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen und/oder zweites juristisches Staatsexamen
  • Idealerweise mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung als Steuerberater und/oder Rechtsanwalt in der Gestaltungsberatung
  • Fundiertes steuerliches, betriebswirtschaftliches und juristisches Wissen mit Fokus auf dem Umwandlungs(steuer)recht und Erbschaftsteuerrecht
  • Engagierte, unternehmerische und selbständige Arbeitsweise
  • DATEV- und MS-Office-Kenntnisse wünschenswert
  • Kommunikative Persönlichkeit und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten

Benefits

Unser Versprechen.

Wir glauben, dass eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit stets auf einem Geben und Nehmen basiert und sind uns dessen bewusst, dass unsere Mitarbeiter der Grundstein unseres Erfolges sind. Deshalb geben wir gerne etwas (mehr) zurück und bieten Ihnen neben einem entsprechend der Stellenanforderung überdurchschnittlichen Gehalt weitere Benefits, wie:

  • Umfassende Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote, denn Ihre Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten inkl. flexibles Home-Office, damit Berufs- und Privatleben unter denselben Hut passen
  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld und frei wählbare Ausstattung
  • Spannende Teamevents
  • Fitnessangebote
  • Parkplätze vor Ort, Firmenvergünstigungen, Getränke und vieles mehr
  • LKC ist einmalig – und über 30-malig in Deutschland – beraten wir mit Leidenschaft, Kompetenz und Charme

Wie es weiter geht.

Sie haben Lust auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um Gestaltungsberatung und weiteren vielseitigen Tätigkeiten in einem persönlichen Umfeld?

Wir bei LKC vereinen das Beste aus diesen zwei Welten und freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: Creative & Paid Social Strategist (d/f/m) - German-speaking
description:
What is Leapsome?

Leapsome is the AI-powered people platform revolutionizing HR for modern teams. Leapsome drives HR excellence and empowers high-performing teams by automating, connecting, and simplifying every HR process across the employee lifecycle — from onboarding and performance management to engagement and development. Built with ease of use in mind, our platform ensures high adoption by employees, managers, and People teams alike.

Our purpose is to make work fulfilling for everyone, and our vision is to reshape the future of work by being the leading People platform for HR excellence and high-performing teams. We enable companies to create environments where people can achieve their goals, learn and grow together, and build genuine motivation & engagement.

Trusted by thousands of organizations globally, Leapsome secured $60 million in Series A funding led by Insight Partners in March 2022. This funding allowed us to further develop our intelligent platform, create exceptional employee experiences, and expand into the US market.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to join Leapsome and be part of reshaping the future of work!

Your Opportunity

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to own the creative engine behind our paid social growth. This role is for someone who lives and breathes creative. You'll lead the research, briefing, testing, and iteration that drives performance on Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube, and you'll think about every creative decision in terms of the business outcome it delivers, not just what looks good. You're a rare blend of creative and technical: you have genuine taste, and you can execute. That means writing the hook, briefing the edit, or cutting the ad yourself when speed matters more than process. You'll partner closely with the Performance Marketing team to scale paid social into a channel that's driven by creative insight rather than just campaign setup, and to help define Leapsome's creative voice as we continue scaling globally.

What you will do:

Creative Strategy & Positioning

  • Develop the positioning, messaging, and creative angles that make HR and People leaders feel understood rather than marketed to.

  • Find the moments, frustrations, goals, and everyday realities that resonate with real HR practitioners.

  • Translate product and platform experiences into concepts that stop the scroll and drive action.

  • Stay close to the customer: watch competitor ads, read comments, study reviews, and let those insights inform every creative decision.

  • Turn performance data and testing results into sharper creative strategy by identifying what's working, what isn't, and what to try next.

Creative Production

  • Own creative across static image, video/B-roll, and partnership/UGC ads. Lead concepting, briefing, and sign-off end to end.

  • Write the copy that anchors the work: hooks, scripts, on-screen text, static copy, and end cards across video and static formats.

  • Recut and remix existing ads quickly to generate high-volume creative iterations, and cut/produce ads yourself when speed matters more than process.

  • Run creator operations end to end: sourcing, contracting, and whitelisting for UGC and partnership creators.

  • Build a steady pipeline of high-performing creative across categories, with a clear test-and-learn cycle behind every concept.

Paid Social Strategy & Media Buying

  • Independently own and operate paid social accounts day to day across Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube. This includes campaign builds, audience/targeting setup, budget allocation, bid strategy, and QA.

  • Make media buying and creative decisions through an ROI lens, tying output to cost per conversion, conversion rate, and pipeline impact, not just creative quality.

  • Manage and forecast paid social budgets in partnership with the Performance Marketing team.

  • Collaborate closely with Growth, Product Marketing, and Design to keep creative aligned with broader campaign strategy.

Who are we looking for?

  • 3+ years in a performance marketing or creative strategy role, with hands-on ownership of paid social creative and campaign management.

  • A track record you can point to: you led a creative strategy that drove a measurable lift in conversions or sign-ups and moved cost per conversion in the right direction.

  • Obsessed with the customer. You think about who you're talking to before you think about what you want to say.

  • Hands-on experience editing video (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).

  • Experience running creator operations end-to-end (sourcing, briefing, contracting, whitelisting) is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (e.g., Midjourney, Higgsfield, AdCreative.ai, or similar) is a strong plus.

  • Comfort working with performance data (Meta/LinkedIn/YouTube Ads Manager, GA4 or equivalent) to inform creative decisions, not just intuition.

  • Strong project management and communication skills. You can run multiple creative workflows and reviews at once without losing quality control.

  • Quick to pick up new tools: AI creative platforms, editing software, growth analytics. Experience with creative analytics platforms (e.g. Motion) is a plus.

  • Working familiarity with paid search platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads). You'll occasionally pitch in on paid search tasks alongside our freelance paid search support.

Benefits

  • Learning and development: Grow your skills with a €2,000 yearly development budget and full access to the Good Habitz platform.

  • Work-from-home stipend: A one-time €1,000 stipend to set up your home workspace.

  • Competitive pay and equity: Competitive salary plus a pre-IPO equity package, so you share in the company's growth.

  • Corporate benefits: Exclusive discounts and deals from our partner network.

  • Vacation: 30 vacation days a year plus public holidays, with the option to upgrade to 40 days at adjusted pay. After 5 years at Leapsome, take a month-long paid sabbatical.

  • Wellness benefits: Stay active with a fully sponsored Urban Sports Club M membership, and support your mental health with an Oliva subscription that includes 1:1 therapy sessions, plus company workshops on mindfulness and digital wellness.

description:
Über uns - Developer Akademie

  • Wir sind ein wachsendes Startup aus dem E-Learning / Education Sektor und ermöglichen es, hunderten aktiven Kundinnen und Kunden als Quereinsteigern eine Karriere in der IT zu starten.
  • Wir bieten so praxisnahe Online-Weiterbildungen an und haben dadurch bereits schon viele hundert Quereinsteiger in Jobs in der IT gebracht. Egal ob sie davor Yoga-Lehrer, Ingenieurinnen, Marketingspezialisten oder Taxifahrer waren.
  • Unser Ziel ist es, den IT-Nachwuchs auszubilden, den Deutschland für die Digitalisierung benötigt. Dafür brauchen wir dich als Verstärkung um unsere ambitionierten Wachstumsziele zu erreichen.


Deine Aufgaben

Wir suchen dich als Verstärkung unseres Teams als Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d). Du gewinnst über gezielte digitale Kampagnen qualifizierte Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer für unsere Weiterbildungen und entwickelst unser Marketing operativ wie strategisch weiter.

  • Du baust, steuerst und optimierst unsere Kampagnen über die relevanten Kanäle (u.a. Google Ads, Meta) und arbeitest dabei eng mit unseren Agenturpartnern zusammen 
  • Du setzt unsere Marketingstrategie in die Praxis um und entwickelst sie auf Basis von Daten und Ergebnissen kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung ein 7-stelliges Marketingbudget und behältst Performance und Effizienz im Blick
  • Du lieferst kreativen Input für Kampagnen, testest neue Formate, Kanäle und KI-Tools und treibst neue Ansätze voran

title: Staff Software Engineer (m/w/d) for telemedicine platform
description:
Deine Rolle bei Ocumeda

As Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) you are the engineer who makes hard, unclear or broken things tractable. You know how our platform works end to end and you shape it as you go. Your focus is our full-stack platform: the web application our doctors, our optician partners, and their customers use daily, and the services behind it.
This is an individual contributor role. No direct reports, real technical authority: you set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and you build in the same codebase as everyone else in the team. Staff/Senior here means deeper, not further from the code. Your job is to keep our systems fast to iterate, reliable in production, and ready for international expansion and scaling.

  • Own the architecture of our full-stack platform – frontend, backend, data, AWS – and evolve it under real product pressure instead of rewriting it
  • Own our testing strategy: where we invest in unit, integration and end-to-end coverage, what we deliberately do not test, and how tests stay fast enough that nobody skips them
  • Push our agentic coding practice forward: tooling, guardrails and testing discipline that make us faster without putting unverified code into a live product
  • Shape scope together with product: surface the cheap 80 % solution, and say clearly when something is not worth building
  • Build so that what ships is operable and auditable by design (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 13485), without turning engineering into paperwork
  • Go wherever the problem is – a scaling bottleneck one week, a broken integration the next – you fix it properly


Das bringst du mit

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience (roughly 7+), most of it on systems that reached real users
  • Deeply hands-on across the stack: strong in the frontend, at home in the backend, comfortable in the infrastructure and web technologies around it
  • A strong background in TypeScript, and well-formed opinions you can defend and revise
  • A clear product focus: you care about what ships, what runs, and what users experience
  • You speak fluent English (C1); German is a plus
... and as a nice to have: 
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up where speed and quality both mattered
  • Comfort taking ownership and shaping processes nobody has defined yet
  • A degree in a STEM field – equivalent practical experience counts more

title: Business Development Director
description:
Do you have the right sales skills to win new business for LanguageWire and at the same time contribute to our growth trajectory? Yes? You should definitely read on!

The role you’ll play 

The Business Development Director will be a key factor in our current growth. The ideal candidate will work across our ecosystem of technology and services to deliver high value solutions to enterprise clients. You will have a consultative mindset and be comfortable managing the large volume of inbound requests we receive as well as cold contacting new prospects up to C-Level stakeholders. 

You’ll be given the training, tools and solutions to target and approach prospective clients, highlight the value of our ecosystem and convert them from prospect to customer. 

The team you’ll be a part of 

You’ll have a crucial role in our LanguageWire Business Development Team for the DACH region and be a key driver of our business in your country. You will report to our Head of Business Development and be a member of his regional teams. You’ll interact with local colleagues in your branch office, but you will also work with colleagues across our value chain up to the C-Team. 

 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by… 

  • Understanding and articulating LanguageWire’s services, capabilities, benefits and competitive advantages and knowing when to involve colleagues for best results 
  • Working across value chain to close inbound leads 
  • Creating leads by researching prospective clients through a mix of strategies 
  • Outreach & follow up prospects & new clients 
  • Representing LanguageWire at commercial events/trade fairs/thought leadership occasions 
  • Pipeline management & forecasting of revenues 
  • Establishing & developing relationships with enterprise targets 
  • Create proposals, lead presentations, manage RFPs & negotiate contracts 
  • Understanding & articulating LanguageWire’s services capabilities, benefits & unique value proposition 
  • Coordinating internal resources, teams and talent to win client trust and drive revenue 
  • Being a strong team player whose contributions, ideas and feedback is well appreciated by the team, and who can always fully rely on the other team members 

 

In one year, you’ll know you were successful if… 

  • You understand our business, the business of your customers and how LanguageWire has provided value to them 
  • Your colleagues can rely on you as a resource for describing in detail the case studies for your book of business and beyond 
  • You have hit your annual target and are well prepared to easily surpass next year’s targets 

 

Desired experience and competencies  

What does it take to work for LanguageWire? 

 

What you’ll need to bring 

  • 3 - 7 years sales experience.  
  • The desire to learn about new technology, solutions and processes and the ability to effectively communicate their benefits to potential clients 
  • Understanding of the sales lifecycle - from lead generation through business closing 
  • Proven track record in achieving sales targets 
  • Proven ability to be self-driven 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
  • Strong interpersonal skills 
  • A consultancy toolbox (problem solving, analytical mindset, stakeholder management, presentation skills etc.) 
  • Effective time management 

 

This will make you stand out  

  • Experience in the translation/content or technology industry preferred 
  • Proven success in SaaS &/or localization sales 
  • Experience integrating platforms & systems to drive value 
  • Strategic and methodical approach to problem solving 

 

Your colleagues say you  

  • Are a team player that elevates the game and players around you 
  • Operate with integrity in all situations 
  • Never quit, even when the going gets tough 
  • Are always open, caring, curious and learning 

  

Our perks 

  • Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas 
  • Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture 
  • International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kyiv, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia 
  • We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.  

 

 

About LanguageWire  

 

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.  

 

Our values drive our behavior 

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.  

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don’t understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We are caring and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture. 

 

Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:   

“At LanguageWire, we use our years of expert experience and knowledge that we've built up in the language industry to share best practices with our customers. We show that we can be a trusted and caring partner by helping our customers to constantly improve their processes by recommending various solutions. In doing so, we can celebrate their successes together”. 

(Anna-Karin, Business Development Director, Varberg)  

 

Yes, to diversity, equity & inclusion  

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work. 

LanguageWire’s recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills. 

 

Want to know more?  

We can’t wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!  

If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our website!

title: AI Field Engineer
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are part of the AI Core team but your work extends beyond it. Most of your time is spent embedded within one of our portfolio groups: responsible for deploying and operating the AI Hub for the companies within that group and integrating AI into their real business processes. Beyond this, you support the M&A team to develop AI driven use cases to support our acquisition strategy. You build production-grade systems, connect AI capabilities to existing infrastructure and make sure what gets deployed actually runs stably in the long term. You step in when complex AI use cases require real engineering work and changes to the companies cloud infrastructure.

What You Will Work On

  • Design and deploy production-grade AI solutions integrated into real operational systems: ERP, accounting tools, email inboxes, and legacy workflows
  • Build, test, and maintain integrations with enterprise services including MCP servers, Microsoft Graph, Git/Bitbucket, and REST APIs
  • You understand that shipping a solution is just the beginning. Your designs gather signals and feedback from operations for a continuous improvement cycle. Ensure AI systems run with full observability: logging, alerting, and audit trails that let non-technical stakeholders understand what is happening.
  • Work closely with AI Champions and portfolio group teams to translate business needs into implementable AI solutions and enable the Champions with your technical expertise to implement more use cases without your help in the future
  • Deploy, configure, and operate AI Hub instances (Open WebUI) for the portfolio companies within your assigned portfolio group: including onboarding, custom model setup, tool integrations, SSO, and ongoing maintenance
  • Support the M&A team to identify new targets, automate outreach and, support Due Diligence of new acquisition targets

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in a DevOps, backend engineering, or platform engineering role
  • Python fluency: you write clean, maintainable code and are comfortable owning a codebase
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure & production deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Solid familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD deployment workflows: including deploying and configuring containerised applications for end-customer environments
  • AI-native: you work with LLMs, know their limits, and have shipped something real using them
  • Strong communication skills: you translate technical decisions into business language and can work effectively with non-technical stakeholders
  • German (native or C2) and English (fluent): both are used daily across teams and OpCos

Bonus

  • Experience integrating AI into ERP, CRM, or accounting systems
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tool-calling patterns
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation)
  • Experience with enterprise authentication and identity (OAuth, SSO, Azure AD / Entra ID)
  • Prior experience working across multiple companies or in a group / holding structure

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A dual role with real variety: strategic platform work at group level combined with hands-on implementation inside a Portfolio Platform
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with regular on-site time
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Account Manager (m/w/d) - Eschborn
description:
